hero.title: Knorr-Bremse Local Care: Social Engagement at Our Company Locations
hero.subtitle: Social engagement at Knorr-Bremse is built around Local Care and Global Care initiatives that support communities near our sites.

initiatives.title: Global Care: Advancing WASH Projects in Southeast Asia
initiatives.description: Knorr-Bremse Global Care continues to fund clean water, sanitation, and hygiene projects, offering new prospects for communities in need.

initiatives.title: Local Care: Employees Volunteer for Urban Greening
initiatives.description: Our local teams partnered with city parks to plant trees, demonstrating our commitment to environmental sustainability.

initiatives.title: Knorr-Bremse Awarded EcoVadis Gold Status
initiatives.description: Recognized for our dedication to sustainable development, corporate social responsibility, and green supply chain initiatives.

initiatives.title: Supporting STEM Education in Local Communities
initiatives.description: Employees volunteer to teach science and robotics, inspiring the next generation of engineers at local schools.
